name: outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.State.mk.noConfusion
type_text:
{q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw} →
  {P : Sort u} →
    {seed : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K} →
      {iteration : ℕ} →
        {x g selected : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d} →
          {clock : NNReal} →
            {nextID : ℕ} →
              {phase : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.Phase q.d q.m q.n} →
                {seed' : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K} →
                  {iteration' : ℕ} →
                    {x' g' selected' : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d} →
                      {clock' : NNReal} →
                        {nextID' : ℕ} →
                          {phase' : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.Phase q.d q.m q.n} →
                            { seed := seed, iteration := iteration, x := x, g := g, selected := selected,
                                  clock := clock, nextID := nextID, phase := phase } =
                                { seed := seed', iteration := iteration', x := x', g := g', selected := selected',
                                  clock := clock', nextID := nextID', phase := phase' } →
                              (seed ≍ seed' →
                                  iteration = iteration' →
                                    x ≍ x' →
                                      g ≍ g' →
                                        selected ≍ selected' → clock = clock' → nextID = nextID' → phase ≍ phase' → P) →
                                P
